description: Phase A audit, zero CSS changes. Build the temporary tooling (compare, coverage, transfer), produce W/.agents/tasks/css-audit.md covering the ordered stylesheet list per in-scope page, per-file size and hand-written/generated/frozen classification, exactly how styles.deduped.min.css is produced and whether it is in sync (rebuild to temp and rule-level diff), raw vs deduped per page, real Edge coverage at 375x812 and 1024x768 with e2e-spec interactions (used vs unused bytes per file), and the 'before' transfer numbers. Independent of FEAT-002..005 except that they consume its tools and numbers.
steps: Read P/.agents/tasks/css-plan.md fully, then W/.agents/tasks/extract-inline-1-verification.md and W/.agents/tasks/tmp-css-snapshot.js. Preflight: git -P status clean on branch refactor/css-consolidate-1, node/Edge/Playwright versions, tests/.cache/cdn present (else copy from P\tests\.cache).

Write W/.agents/tasks/tmp-css-compare.js per plan section 2 (incl. --allow overflow-container) and tmp-css-transfer.js. Capture snap-A0 with tmp-css-snapshot.js into $env:TEMP\css-consolidate-1\snap-A0 and run the compare against .agents/tasks/css-baseline: must be 0 diffs (negative self-test: compare against a copy where one cell is edited, expect exit 1).

Write tmp-css-coverage.js (plan A.4): msedge, page.coverage.startCSSCoverage({resetOnNavigation:false}), every in-scope page at 375x812 and 1024x768, replay interactions derived from reading every tests/e2e/*.spec.js and tests/helpers/*.js, union used ranges per URL (query stripped, CDN ignored), save $env:TEMP\css-consolidate-1\coverage.json.

Build the audit data with small throwaway Node snippets: page->ordered stylesheet table (parse HTML), per-file bytes/lines/rules/classification, reverse index, deduped rebuild to $env:TEMP\css-consolidate-1\css-audit\regen.css (twice, identical SHA-256) and the rule-level drift report, git archaeology (af170e2, styles.purged.css, 072bc5d), deploy-file consequences, sw.js precache vs page URL mismatches, server.js cache headers, raw-vs-deduped history per page via git log -S.

Run tmp-css-transfer.js into $env:TEMP\css-consolidate-1\transfer-before.json and put per-file bytes + total CSS for recipients.html and leaderboard.html (decoded, transferred, gzip) into the audit. Run the baseline e2e (npm test *> $env:TEMP\css-consolidate-1\e2e-before.txt) and record counts (expect 121 passed, 0 failed, 11 skipped).

Write W/.agents/tasks/css-audit.md with every table and appendix from plan A.2-A.5 (including the explicit limitation paragraph about dynamically-added classes, the top-30 uncovered rules per file as REPORT ONLY, dead-rule report for the deduped file as report only). Commit only that file: docs(css): add stylesheet audit and coverage report.
acceptance_criteria: git -P diff --stat HEAD~1 shows only .agents/tasks/css-audit.md; no file under public/ changed
css-audit.md lists, for each of the 14 in-scope pages, the ordered stylesheets with ?v and byte sizes, and excludes bottom-tab-bar-snippet.html and tab-bar-demo.html

css-audit.md states the exact command, tool versions, inputs and (absent) safelist that produce styles.deduped.min.css, whether it is committed, and the measured drift (counts + changed-declaration list) against a rebuild
css-audit.md reports per-file used vs unused bytes from real Edge coverage for both viewports and the interactions replayed, plus the limitation paragraph
tmp-css-compare.js on css-baseline vs snap-A0 exits 0 and its negative self-test exits 1
verification: npm test  (121 passed, 0 failed, 11 skipped, or the recorded reference)
findings:
FEAT-001 done; commit e2cc2a4 on refactor/css-consolidate-1 touches only .agents/tasks/css-audit.md (889 lines, all A.2-A.5 tables + appendices). No file under public/ changed. Nothing pushed, no cr.

Audit helpers: tmp-css-audit-pages.js, -drift.js <regen.css>, -git.js, -analyze.js, -manual.js, -build.js (build regenerates css-audit.md from TEMP data), tmp-css-rootcheck.js. All are throwaway; delete at the very end with the other tmp-css-*.js.

EVIDENCE in $env:TEMP\css-consolidate-1 (C:\Users\matmamon\AppData\Local\Temp\css-consolidate-1): coverage.json (per file: bytes, used, rangesMerged indexed into the CRLF served text, usedPerRun, usedPerViewport, matchesDisk=true for all 19 files; also runs/inline/log/navigated=[]), coverage.log.txt, transfer-before.json, e2e-before.txt, snap-A0/ (56 files), css-audit/{pages.json,drift.json,analyze.json,git.txt,regen-cli1.css,regen-cli2.css,manual.json,extra.json}. coverage-run1-leaderboard-navigated.json is a discarded first run (leaderboard podium click navigated away and lost coverage).

pm test on e939a28: 121 passed, 0 failed, 11 skipped (7.0 min) -> reference counts for later phases.

DRIFT (styles.deduped.min.css vs rebuild 
px postcss public/styles.css -o out): rebuild is deterministic (two runs, SHA-256 1ff9cf6c...3c94, 35,231 B); committed blob 40,111 B (LF, 38 lines, not 35), SHA eb22c6e6...2b18. Rule-level (keyframe steps included): committed 399 rules, rebuild 357; identical 314, changed declarations 13, only-committed 72 (7,856 B), only-rebuild 30 (3,197 B). Not in sync -> Phase B should expect the frozen fallback (B.6). Git: 8d441c7/026f853 changed only the min file; 072bc5d hand-removed .recipient-item .alert-warning; postcss.config.js got the *-page*.css glob only in 052ff8f (after the file was last touched).

DEFECT FOUND (important for B/C): public/styles.css lines 5643-5648 is a truncated .profile-picture-placeholder rule (cut after display: flex !important;), so the :root{...} copy at 5650-5679 (closed by }}) is a NESTED rule (.profile-picture-placeholder :root, never matches). Same nesting exists in the committed min file and in the rebuild. Measured in Edge 155: effective --ios-success is #34c759 on both recipients (deduped) and leaderboard (raw), so the committed #00693E in the nested :root has no effect. postcss walkRules returns that nested rule with parent.type==='rule' (the plan's context-chain code and tmp-css-rulecheck must handle rule parents, not only at-rules). Not fixed (out of scope).

NUMBERS: styles.css = 2,312 rules (keyframe steps excluded; 2,365 with them), 17,641 lines, 437,177 B CRLF; 1,770 exact duplicate rules (300,509 B of 419,525 B LF). aws-design.css 616 rules. Edge coverage (union, 375x812+1024x768, 30 runs, 0 errors): styles.css used 5,872/437,177; styles.deduped.min.css 20,905/40,148; aws-design.css 25,600/114,692 (77.7% unused); bottom-tab-bar 17,022/26,165; app-theme 9,207/14,403; filters 3,664/13,023; chat-reactions 6,796/12,051; leaderboard-page 18,981/23,853; all local CSS 171,294/793,263 B used. Dead-by-token (crude, report only) for the min file: 36 of 373 rules, 4,050 B. Crude dynamic prefixes found: alert-, e2e-cue-, editComments-, editTitle-, lp-, notif-, recipient-, thread-; suffix -collapse (Phase C dyn scanner must redo this properly).

TRANSFER BEFORE (transfer-before.json, 375x812, cold, SW blocked): recipients local CSS decoded 237,999 B / transferred 43,940 B (brotli; the server negotiates br via compression) / gzip-6 41,509 B across 6 sheets; leaderboard decoded 501,598 B / transferred 28,649 B / gzip-6 40,335 B across 4 sheets (styles.css alone 437,177 decoded, 14,333 br, 26,519 gzip). Wire savings from dedupe are small with br; the win is parse/memory size and maintainability. Re-measure with the same tool for transfer-after.json.

SW / MAIN: main is now 4f94a3c and its sw.js says CACHE_NAME 'prezenty-v127' (worktree still v125). Final bump must be at least prezenty-v128 (re-check main and refactor/split-recipients-1 right before bumping). sw.js precache mismatches (reported, not fixed): recipients requests aws-design.css?v=4 but precache has /aws-design.css; wiadomosci requests chat-reactions.css?v=3 vs precached /chat-reactions.css; bottom-tab-bar.css, app-theme.css, filters.css, styles.css, remixicon and FA 6.4.0 are not precached; sw is cache-first with no ignoreSearch. Deploy files (Dockerfile --only=production, render.yaml npm install, vercel.json -> server.js) never build CSS. JS-injected CSS: desktop-nav.js:10-13 remixicon link, update-checker.js:98 style element.

HARNESS QUIRKS: (1) CDP reports inline <style> under the document URL (e.g. /formularz.html); coverage script classifies those as inline. (2) Leaderboard podium/user-card click navigates to /recipients.html?osoba= (leaderboard-page.js:256) and wipes coverage, so those are hover-only; coverage script has a navigation guard that logs WARN and goBack. (3) Browser-side inline byte counts are LF-folded, a few dozen bytes below HTML-side sizes. (4) The execute_pwsh tool swallowed output of long multi-statement PowerShell commands that use here-strings or .Replace on files: use small node scripts, run steps separately, and verify edits with grep. (5) postcss prints 'browsers data is 16 months old' (caniuse-lite 1.0.30001727) on every build; harmless. (6) postcss.parse of the min file yields a Declaration with undefined value inside the nested :root; code that inspects decl.value must coerce with String(). (7) Playwright tests/.report is git-ignored; git status is clean apart from untracked tmp-css-*.js. (8) Coverage skips in demo data: archiwum/rezerwacje list items absent, home has no sidebar button, formularz #quickAddToggle not clickable at 1024 (listed in css-audit.md section 7).
